description:
About Dispensed

At Dispensed ,we are passionate about empowering individuals to reach their full potential by supporting better health outcomes. We believe that access to innovative and alternative therapies can transform lives. Through our telehealth platform, we facilitate patient access to affordable, efficient, and reliable alternative medicine services across Australia, NZ and the UK.

About the role

Across the business, our teams are doing manual work every day that a well-built system could take on instead. We want one person whose job is to find that work and give teams their time back by building real automation and putting it into production.

We're a telehealth business operating across Australia, the UK and New Zealand, covering patient onboarding, prescriber workflows, pharmacy fulfilment, clinical admin and patient support. We've already proven this kind of work can be automated - now we want to build it in-house.

This is a hands-on role - less overseeing, more building and delivering.

What you'll own

• Work alongside teams to identify the parts of their work that could be automated

• Build the automation, agent, tool or integration that fixes it, and get it into production

• Measure the impact - establish a baseline before you start, then track what changed

• Set the team up for success by handing over automations once they're stable, documented and the team knows how to run it

• Keep track of what's newly possible in AI and turn that into things we can stop doing manually

• Bring the AI enablement work we currently outsource in-house

Your first 90 days will focus on three areas: patient support, then clinic and prescriber operations, then pharmacy order operations. Ideally, you'll have something built and running within a month.

What you'll need

Essential:

• Proven experience building AI-powered agents, apps, automations or internal tools that saw real use

• The ability to code and deploy independently, without relying on other teams

• Solid skills in prompting, evaluation, retrieval, APIs, and data handling, plus enough security awareness to handle patient data properly

• A good instinct for finding where the real time savings are in an unfamiliar process

• The ability to earn trust with busy, non-technical operators

• Able to work without a ready-made backlog - you identify what needs doing

Nice to have:

• Experience in healthcare, telehealth or another regulated industry

• Background in forward-deployed or solutions engineering

• Founder or early-stage startup experience

• We operate under Australian privacy law, UK GDPR and NZ requirements, plus medicinal cannabis regulation in three countries. Some automations need a different approach

• Success means what's still running six months later, not how many things were built

• This role works best when it fits naturally into how teams already operate

What We Offer

• Work From Anywhere

• A competitive salary & benefits package

• A supportive and positive work environment

How to apply

Send us your CV plus a couple of examples of what you've built - an agent, a tool, an automation. A repo, video or a short write-up. Applications without a build example won't be considered.

title: Fullstack Engineer - Marketplace
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset - who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Snowflake is at the forefront of the data and AI revolution - with a mission to help every company achieve its potential with data & AI. As part of our mission to enable every organization to achieve its full potential, the Snowflake Marketplace https://www.snowflake.com/en/product/features/marketplace/snowflake-marketplace-for-providers/ serves as the vibrant hub which enables customers to do more with data. We are building a platform that empowers organizations to seamlessly discover, access, and build with valuable datasets, cutting-edge applications, and intelligent AI agents.

With the rapid growth of the Snowflake Marketplace, we are rethinking the architecture and reimagining the user experience to build a best-in-class product that scales to meet the demands of our global customer and partner ecosystem. We are looking for a Software Engineer who is passionate about creating exceptional user experiences and driving customer value. This is a high-impact role where you will have a direct impact on the product and the opportunity to grow your skills in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

AS A SOFTWARE ENGINEER AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

- Design, develop, and deliver features across our full stack that have a direct impact on our customers and partners.

- Work closely with product managers, designers, and other engineers to deliver end-to-end features.

- Build robust and high-performance systems to support the Marketplace platform, using technologies like TypeScript, React, Go, Java, and Python.

- Write clean, well-tested, and maintainable code, while contributing to a culture of engineering excellence and continuous improvement.

- Be a strong contributor to the overall product and technical direction of the area

 

OUR IDEAL SOFTWARE ENGINEER WILL HAVE:

- 4 + years of industry experience designing and building scalable web applications with a focus on great user experience.

- A strong foundation in full-stack development. You should have significant frontend experience with TypeScript and React, and experience with backend services in languages like Java, Go, or Python.

- A genuine passion for building customer-facing products and a drive to solve problems that create real value for users.

- A strong understanding of core computer science concepts and web application architecture, including security, performance, and scalability.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?
